title: VMMU: A Vietnamese Multitask Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark

model.params_source: paper Appendix B Table 10 (o3-2025-04-16, reasoning_effort medium = default; temperature N/A for o3, values here are placeholders); max tokens not stated

task.approximation: Vietnamese prompt (vn_prompt) taken as the main setting - the paper's English-instruction variant is an ablation that lowers accuracy by ~1 point; items with multiple_question use the Figure 11 (multiple answers) prompt.

prompt.user_template: Trả lời câu hỏi trắc nghiệm trong hình. Ghi đáp án bạn chọn trong dấu ngoặc nhọn với chữ cái tương ứng, ví dụ: {Z}.

placeholders.image: items.image attached as an image content part (not expressible)

prompt.source_location: Appendix C, Figure 10 (Integrated-MM prompt; English variant 'Answer the multiple-choice question in the image. Put your choice in curly brackets with the option letter, e.g. {Z}.'); Figure 11 for multi-question images

output.parse_paper: regex: last '{([A-Z])}' (multi-question images: list of letters)

metric.definition: macro mean over the 7 domains of per-domain accuracy (Table 3 'Mean')
